tasks.title: Lecture #3
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a psychology class.
tasks.transcript: Today we're going to talk about shyness and discuss recent research on ways to help children learn to interact socially. Many people consider themselves shy. In fact, forty percent of people who took part in our survey said they were shy--- that's two out of every five people. And there are studies to indicate that the tendency toward shyness may be inherited. But just because certain children are timid doesn't mean they are doomed to be shy forever. There are things parents, teachers, and the children themselves can do to overcome this tendency--- and even to prevent it. One researcher found that if parents gently push their shy children to try new things, they can help these children become less afraid and less inhibited. Another way to help shy children is to train them in social skills. For example, there are special training groups where children are taught things like looking at other children while talking to them, talking about other people's interests, and even smiling. These groups have been very successful at giving shy children a place to feel safe and accepted, and at building up their self-esteem.

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the talk?

options.A: To discuss the causes of shyness in children
options.B: To describe ways to help shy children improve their social skills
options.C: To explain the results of a survey about shyness
options.D: To discuss the emotional effects of shyness on children

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这次谈话的主要目的是什么？ 定位原文：Today we're going to talk about shyness and discuss recent research on ways to help children learn to interact socially. ... There are things parents, teachers, and the children themselves can do to overcome this tendency... 选项分析： A. 讨论儿童害羞的原因。演讲中虽然提到了害羞可能是遗传的，但这只是一笔带过，并非主要目的，因此A选项错误。 B. 描述帮助害羞儿童提高社交技能的方法。演讲开篇即点明要讨论帮助儿童学习社交的方法，随后具体介绍了两种方式：父母温和地推动孩子尝试新事物，以及通过特殊训练小组培训社交技巧，因此B选项正确。 C. 解释一项关于害羞的调查结果。演讲中提到了一个调查数据（40%的人害羞），但这只是引出话题的背景信息，并非演讲的核心目的，因此C选项错误。 D. 讨论害羞对儿童的情感影响。演讲没有重点讨论害羞带来的情感影响，而是聚焦于如何克服害羞，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is one way to help shy children become less shy?

options.B: Gently encouraging them to try new things

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：根据演讲者的说法，帮助害羞儿童变得不那么害羞的一种方法是什么？ 定位原文：One researcher found that if parents gently push their shy children to try new things, they can help these children become less afraid and less inhibited. 选项分析： A. 给他们更多独立性。原文并未提及给予独立性，而是强调在父母的推动下尝试新事物，因此A选项错误。 B. 温和地鼓励他们尝试新事物。这与原文中“gently push their shy children to try new things”的描述完全一致，因此B选项正确。 C. 完全避免社交场合。这与帮助孩子克服害羞的目标背道而驰，因此C选项错误。 D. 专注于学业成就。原文完全没有提及学业，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: Based on the talk, why are special training groups beneficial for shy children?

options.A: They help children feel less anxious and more confident in social situations
options.B: They allow children to avoid confronting their fears directly
options.C: They focus on academic skills rather than social interactions
options.D: They encourage children to be more independent and self-reliant

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：根据谈话内容，为什么特殊训练小组对害羞的儿童有益？ 定位原文：These groups have been very successful at giving shy children a place to feel safe and accepted, and at building up their self-esteem. 选项分析： A. 它们帮助儿童在社交场合感到不那么焦虑，更加自信。原文提到这些小组为孩子们提供了一个感到安全和被接纳的地方，并建立了他们的自尊，这正对应了减少焦虑、增加自信的效果，因此A选项正确。 B. 它们允许孩子避免直接面对自己的恐惧。这些小组正是通过训练社交技巧来帮助孩子面对恐惧，而非逃避，因此B选项错误。 C. 它们关注学业技能而非社交互动。这些小组专门训练社交技能，如交谈时看着对方、谈论他人兴趣等，因此C选项错误。 D. 它们鼓励孩子更加独立和自力更生。原文强调的是在小组中获得安全感和建立自尊，并未直接讨论独立性的培养，因此D选项错误。

questions.stem: What is the function of the sentence "In fact, forty percent of people who took part in our survey said they were shy--- that's two out of every five people." in the talk?

options.A: To provide statistical evidence supporting the commonality of shyness
options.B: To introduce the topic of inherited shyness
options.C: To describe the negative effects of shyness on people
options.D: To explain the results of a study on social interaction

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：谈话中“事实上，参与我们调查的人中有百分之四十说自己害羞——也就是每五个人中有两个。”这句话的作用是什么？ 定位原文：Many people consider themselves shy. In fact, forty percent of people who took part in our survey said they were shy--- that's two out of every five people. 选项分析： A. 提供统计数据证明害羞的普遍性。说话者先提出“很多人认为自己害羞”，然后用具体的调查数据（40%）来支撑这一观点，说明害羞确实很普遍，因此A选项正确。 B. 引入遗传性害羞的话题。遗传性害羞是在这句话之后才提到的（And there are studies to indicate...），这句话本身并未涉及遗传，因此B选项错误。 C. 描述害羞对人的负面影响。这句话仅仅陈述了害羞的人数比例，并未讨论任何负面影响，因此C选项错误。 D. 解释一项关于社交互动的研究结果。这句话是关于害羞普遍性的调查结果，而非关于社交互动的研究，因此D选项错误。
